done_when: forge merge enable's close skips the model review and instead records a clean result only after a mechanical check that the fix changes nothing but forge.toml's top-level merge setting, set to agent (every other parsed setting equal to the default branch's); any other change is refused with a plain reason and no review; tests and CI still run and the owner still merges; no other item skips review; a command test covers a new repo and one adopted on an earlier release, including a refused case with an extra change
why: forge merge enable runs the normal model review on its one-line forge.toml change; if that review blocks (for example on a missing proof list), no one can fix it: agents may never touch the merge setting and the owner would have to repair a change Forge wrote.
